line: Crowley's Knight of Cups: Yodh of the Name (pdf p139); the fiery part of Water and the span from Aquarius to Pisces (pdf p149).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Knights (pdf p139) and on the Knight of Cups (pdf p149).

quotes.quote: The Knights represent the powers of the letter Yodh in the Name.
The Knight of Cups represents the fiery part of Water, the swift passionate attack of rain and springs

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Aquarius to the 20th degree of Pisces (pdf p149); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: He rules the Heavens from the 21st degree of Aquarius to the 20th degree of Pisces.
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Knight of Cups (pdf p149).

quotes.quote: He is graceful, dilettante, with the qualities of Venus, or a weak Jupiter.
